canvas.bounds_convention: x/y inclusive start; x+width/y+height exclusive end

measurement.method: Visual inspection of both original-resolution reference renders; rectangles manually bounded around visible elements. Centers, corners and edge anchors calculated from rectangles.
measurement.accuracy: Approximate visible boxes, generally within several source pixels; no claim of exact segmentation, baseline recovery, font identification or alpha extraction.
measurement.shared_geometry: Unspecified Spanish rectangles inherit English. A locale override records a meaningful observed text/reflow difference; it does not establish pixel-identical artwork across separately generated locale images.
measurement.text_box_note: Text bounds include a small margin around observed glyphs. Use a single shared font system with measured baselines at implementation; these boxes are positioning references, not independently rendered text/button assets.
measurement.glyph_bounds: Bright foreground pixel bounds inside each manually inspected text rectangle. Foreground threshold isolates silver, gold or cyan text; this is a measured alignment aid, not font extraction.

placement.point_transform: screen_x = offset_x + source_x*s; screen_y = offset_y + source_y*s
placement.do_not: Do not stretch X and Y independently. Do not present the full composite as a clean background or extracted sprite set.
placement.safe_area: Reference excludes operating-system chrome. Fit app content inside safe areas; report additional letterboxing at different aspect ratios.
placement.touch_regions: Interactive rectangles follow current visible layout. Actual accessibility hit areas may extend beyond them without moving artwork; resolve competing targets explicitly.

render_strategy.verification: Build the complete screen, then capture the complete 853×1844 fixture once per locale and compare full-screen overlays/difference. Only recapture after material corrections.
render_strategy.asset_reuse: Use a shared background/art layer, shared slot/chrome components and editable locale text. Do not generate/render isolated screen instances for each button or small element.
render_strategy.baked_source_constraint: The approved PNGs are opaque complete composites. Cropping an icon/character rectangle preserves its surrounding baked background. These bounds alone cannot produce transparent reusable icons, an equippable avatar, clean empty panels or editable labels.
render_strategy.exact_fixture: Displaying the immutable full composite reproduces the exact raster fixture, but by itself is not a dynamic production UI or customizable character. Treat any such display as a reference mode and label it honestly.
render_strategy.dynamic_xp: Runtime XP must be 1240/2000 = 0.62, independent of the reference glow extent.
